map.hostingErrorToast: Hosting a server. Stop it first to join.
map.publishDesc: Your server will appear on unlim.cc/list so other players can discover it.
map.ud_term_sub: Drive the session the other side is sharing
map.ud_term_noperr: Connect first. On the other side, run `unlim -S <command>` to share a session.
map.ud_desk_sub: Watch — and with permission, drive — the other screen
map.ud_desk_share_hint: Sharing lets the connected peer see this screen and drive it — the share itself is the control permission.
map.ud_lan_sub: Reach the devices the other side shares with this key
map.ud_lan_none: Nothing is shared with this key
map.ud_lan_legacy: This host runs an older Unlim, so this screen cannot show what it shares. Ask the host to update Unlim.
map.ud_lan_nopeer: Connect first. The services the other side shares with this key appear here.
map.ud_gw_sub: Exit to the internet through the other computer
map.ud_gw_apponly: Application-only: point a program at the proxy below. Everything else keeps using your own connection.
map.ud_gw_creds: Credentials are random per session — never stored, and never sent anywhere but to this screen.
map.ud_gw_nopeer: Connect first. If the other side shares its internet connection with this key, you can turn the proxy on here.
map.ud_gw_nogrant: The key you connected with does not include the internet connection.
map.ud_lan_primary_off: The host has not shared any of its LAN devices with this key. The host can turn sharing on in its own LAN Share screen, or give you a share key.
map.ud_gw_primary_off: The host has not turned on internet sharing for this key.
map.ud_lan_host_title: Shared with the main invite key
map.ud_lan_host_warn: Anyone with your main invite key will be able to reach these devices. For specific people, prefer a share key.
map.ud_lan_host_none: No LAN devices are shared with the main invite key.
map.ud_lan_host_unshare_c: Stop sharing this device with the main invite key?
map.ud_lan_host_bad: Enter an IP address and a port between 1 and 65535.
map.ud_lan_host_public: This is a public room, so LAN devices can never be shared with its key.
map.ud_gw_host_title: Internet sharing for the main invite key
map.ud_gw_host_warn: Anyone with your main invite key could use this computer's internet connection — traffic would appear to come from you.
map.ud_gw_host_share: Share this computer's internet with the main key
map.ud_gw_host_public: This is a public room, so this computer's internet can never be shared with its key.
map.ud_desk_viewonly: View-only for now — this device has not allowed input control. If permission is already on, restart Unlim: a running process never sees a new grant.
map.ud_desk_nocapture: This device cannot share its own screen. It can still watch another one.
map.ud_desk_noperr: Connect first. Then this shows the screen the other side is sharing.
map.authDesc: This host requires a 6-digit access code. Ask whoever runs it for the code their authenticator app is showing:
map.authErrUsed: That code has already been used. Ask for the current one.
map.authErrExpired: That code has expired. Ask for the one showing now.
map.authErrLocked: Too many wrong codes. Locked out for a while.
map.authErrRate: Too many attempts too quickly. Try again shortly.
map.authErrDayCap: This host has had too many failed attempts today. Try again later.
map.authErrBanned: This host has banned this device.
map.authErrHostClock: This device's clock and the host's disagree, so codes can't match. Check the time here (turn automatic time on).
map.updBody:
Current: {current}
Restart to open the new version.
map.setIntro: Decide who can connect to this computer and what they can use. Nothing here changes unless you change it.
map.setAuthDesc: Ask everyone for a 6-digit code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy…) before they can connect.
map.setAuthOn: On — everyone needs the current 6-digit code
map.setAuthOff: Off — no code is asked for
map.setAuthDegraded: On, but the saved code can’t be read — set it up again
map.setAuthStep1: Scan this with your authenticator app
map.setAuthRecWarn: Shown once. Keep them somewhere safe — they’re how you get back in if you lose your phone.
map.setAuthStep3: Enter the current 6 digits to turn it on
map.setAuthNoMatch: That code didn’t match. Try the one showing now.
map.setWlDesc: Only devices you add here can connect at all — everyone else is turned away.
map.setWlOn: On — only listed devices can connect
map.setWlOff: Off — the list is not enforced
map.setWlOffline: Start hosting to manage who’s allowed — the whitelist applies to your live session.
map.setWlShort: Let in only the devices you list
map.setAuthSetupRowSub: Scan a QR into your authenticator app
map.setExemptIntro: These devices connect without being asked for a code.
map.setStateUnknown: Can’t read the current state — is Unlim running?
map.setAuthOffConfirm: Turning this off deletes the current code and its recovery codes. You will scan a new QR next time you turn it on.
map.setLightDesc: Flip the app and the terminal to black text on white. Easier on e-ink screens.
map.setSharesShort: Invites that open only what you pick
map.setSharesIntro: A share key is a second invite that opens only what you tick — some ports, the desktop, files, a device on your network. Give it instead of your main key; remove it and its holders are cut off at once.
map.setSharesOffline: Start hosting first — share keys exist only while Unlim is hosting on this computer.
map.setSharesEmpty: No share keys yet. Make one to give someone less than your main key.
map.setShareNewIntro: Choose exactly what this key opens. Anything left off stays locked.
map.setShareOnceWarn: Shown once — the key is not stored anywhere. Send it now; you can always make another.
map.setShareRevokeConfirm: Revoke this key? Everyone connected with it is disconnected immediately.
map.setShareNeedCap: Pick at least one thing this key opens.
map.capPortsD: Which of your shared ports the key may open
map.grantNoExpiry: no expiry · ends when Unlim stops here
map.capLanD: Let this key reach a device at your home or office — a NAS, printer, camera or local AI server. Only the exact address and port you add here; the rest of your network stays closed.
map.capLanWarn: Whoever has this key can talk to these devices as if they were plugged into your network. Many home devices have weak or no passwords — add only what you would let a guest in your home use.
map.capInternetD: Their apps can go online through this computer, as a proxy they switch on in Apps → Internet Gateway. Only apps they point at the proxy use it.
map.capInternetWarn: Websites will see YOUR internet address for everything they do through it — anything abusive or illegal traces back to you. Only for people you fully trust.
map.capExpiryNote: Every share key also ends when Unlim on this computer stops or restarts — make a new one then.
map.capLanBadAddr: Device address looks wrong — use IP:port, e.g. 192.168.1.10:445
map.capLanNoPort: Add the port after the address, e.g. 192.168.1.10:445
map.capLanNoName: Use the device’s IP address (e.g. 192.168.1.10:445), not its name.
map.capLanBlocked: This address can’t be shared (this computer itself, broadcast, multicast or cloud metadata). Use the device’s own address on your network.
map.setMainD: The invite on the home screen. It opens everything you host — give it only to people you fully trust.
map.setMainWarn: Everyone with your main key can use the network devices / internet listed above. Turn them off in Apps → LAN Share or Internet Gateway when nobody needs them.
map.setMainPublic: not available in a public room
map.ud_err_lan_notshared: The host does not share that device with your key.
map.ud_err_gw_notshared: The host does not share its internet connection with your key.
map.ud_err_not_host: The computer you are connected to is not the room's host, so it shares no network devices or internet.
map.ud_err_bind: Could not open a local port on this device — another program may be using it.
map.ud_err_literal: Use the device's IP address (like 192.168.1.20), not its name.
map.ud_err_multi: More than one computer is connected, so Unlim can't tell which one to use. Disconnect the others and try again.
map.ud_err_nopeer: Not connected to the host. Connect first, then try again.
map.ud_err_unsupported: The host does not offer this on the current connection — it runs an older Unlim, or access is not confirmed yet.
map.ud_err_noanswer: The host did not answer. Check the connection and try again.
map.ud_err_unreachable: The host could not reach that device. Check that it is switched on and that the address and port are right.
map.ud_lan_host_sharekey: Make a share key for one person instead
map.ud_gw_host_sharekey: Make a share key for one person instead
map.ud_gw_howto_browser: Web browser: set its HTTPS proxy (or your system's) to {http} and sign in with the user and password above when asked. Only https:// sites go through it — browsers can't use a SOCKS5 proxy that has a password.
map.ud_gw_howto_os: Whole computer — Windows: Settings › Network & internet › Proxy › Manual proxy setup, address 127.0.0.1, port {port}. macOS: System Settings › Network › your network › Details › Proxies › Secure web proxy (HTTPS), 127.0.0.1 port {port}. Plain http:// pages won't load through it.
map.ud_gw_howto_apps: Other apps and tools: use SOCKS5 at {socks} with the user and password above, or paste the proxy URL.
map.ud_gw_howto_test: Check it works — this should print the other computer's internet address:
map.ud_gw_howto_after: When you're done, turn the proxy off here and remove the proxy setting you made, or pages will stop loading.
map.ud_gw_stopped: The proxy stopped on its own. Turn it on again if you still need it — it will get a new password.
map.ud_gw_stopped_peer: The proxy stopped because the connection to the other computer ended. Reconnect, then turn it on again.
map.ud_gw_stopped_resume: The proxy paused because the connection to the other computer ended. It comes back by itself — same ports, same password — if that computer reconnects within 15 minutes.
map.ud_key_hostdecides: if the host is sharing it
map.ud_key_yes: you can use the host's connection
map.ud_key_noexp: No set end — but it stops working if the host restarts Unlim or removes the key.
map.ud_key_expired: This key has expired. Ask the host for a new one.
map.ud_key_ends: Ends in {t} — sooner if the host restarts Unlim or removes it.
map.ud_lan_dead: Not working — the connection it used has ended. Remove it, and map it again after reconnecting.
map.ud_lan_down: Waiting for the host — the connection ended. This map comes back by itself when you reconnect to the same host.
map.ud_lan_udp_note: UDP: Unlim can't confirm the device answers
map.ud_rs_unsupported: Not offered by this host (older Unlim, or access not confirmed yet)
map.ud_rs_host_lan: You are the host — open to share devices with your clients
map.ud_rs_host_gw: You are the host — open to share this computer’s internet
map.ui_sub_lan: Share a device on your network
map.ui_term_confirm: Let people who join use a shell on this PC?
map.ui_term_help: Anyone with your invite key can type commands on this computer while this is on. Turn it on only for people you trust, and turn it off when you are done.
map.ui_desk_control_confirm: Let people who join control this screen?
map.ui_desk_help: With Control on, the people watching can move your mouse and type on this computer. View lets them watch only.
map.ui_gw_help: People who join can send their traffic out through your connection. Websites will see your address, and what they do may be traced back to you.
map.ui_lan_intro: Devices people who join can reach
map.ui_lan_help: Each device you add here can be reached by everyone who joins with your invite key — only that address and port, nothing else on your network. Remove it when you are done.
map.ui_share_note: Only apps you have turned on work
map.ui_share_need: Pick at least one thing this key opens.
map.ui_share_once: The key is shown only now
map.ui_share_revoke_confirm: Revoke this key? Anyone using it is disconnected.
map.setWlNoneConnected: No one is connected right now.
map.setWlEmptyWarn: The list is empty, so no one can join.
map.ui_err_denied_help: This host lets in only the devices on its whitelist, or asks for a code. Send the host your device ID (Settings › Whitelist › This device), or ask for the code showing now.
map.ui_err_noconn_help: Check the key, and that the host is still running.
map.ui_share_lan_confirm: Turn on LAN sharing for per-person keys ({n} devices)?
map.ui_share_lan_help: Your LAN switch is off. Turning it on for per-person keys only lets this key reach its own devices — people who join with your main invite key still reach no LAN device.
map.setWlNoEffect: The whitelist did not change. Try again.
map.setWlSelfNote: Joining a host with a whitelist? Send them this ID.
map.ud_term_sub_host: A shell session on this PC
map.ui_share_ko_confirm: Turn on {apps} for per-person keys only?
map.ui_share_ko_help: Your {apps} switch is off. Creating this key turns it on for per-person keys only: this key (and any other per-person key that includes it) gets it, and people who join with your main invite key still get nothing.
map.ui_denied_id: Send this device ID to the host
map.ui_err_ko_old: This Unlim is too old to share with per-person keys only. Update Unlim first.
map.ud_qr_hint: Hold the QR code up to the camera — or drop or paste a picture of it here.
map.ud_qr_denied_mac: Unlim is not allowed to use the camera. Turn it on in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Camera, then try again.
map.ud_qr_denied_win: Camera access is off. Turn on “Let desktop apps access your camera” in Settings › Privacy & security › Camera, then try again.
map.ud_qr_denied: Camera access was blocked. Allow Unlim to use the camera, then try again.
map.ud_qr_nocam: No camera found. Open or paste a picture of the QR code instead, or paste the key into the key field.
map.ud_qr_busy: Another app is using the camera. Close it, then try again.
map.ud_qr_camfail: The camera could not start. Open or paste a picture of the QR code instead.
map.ud_qr_nodecoder: QR codes cannot be read on this device. Paste the key into the key field instead.
map.ud_qr_noqr: No QR code found in that picture. Try a sharper or closer one.
map.ud_qr_noclip: No picture on the clipboard. Copy the QR code image first.
map.ui_refused_help: Name or allow it in Settings › Devices.
map.dev_claim_conflict: More than one device claims this name
map.dev_claim_note: claimed = a name they gave themselves (unverified)
map.dev_rename_hint_claim: You can keep their claimed name
map.dev_cannot_name: An older Unlim can’t be given a nickname
map.dev_ban_sub: They stay out until you lift it
map.exempt_confirm_q: Let this device skip the code?
map.err_nick_claimed: “{who}” is only a claimed name — pick one
map.err_nick_needs_confirm: Check that this is the right device
map.err_nick_prefix_short: Type at least 4 characters of the ID
map.err_nick_invalid: Letters, digits, . _ - only; start with a letter
map.err_nick_looks_id: Looks like an ID — pick another name
map.err_nick_stale: The list changed — check it again
